deploybot: [SEC-GATE] RC-5.0.0 (sha256:9b8c7d6...) failed SBOM provenance check: missing provenance.builder_id and license-scanner reported 1 AMBIG license for 'util-async'. Blocking prod promotion.

oscar: We planned the global cutover tonight. Need a fast call: allow a short staging carveout, pin prod to rc-4.9.9, or delay change window.

kim: The ambig license has been in downstream deps for months, previous releases passed. The SBOM uploader hit a permission race so provenance wasn't attached. I can attach cosign and try to re-upload provenance but might take 20m.

security: For staging-only we can approve if cosign present + runtime mitigations. Prod requires provenance or legal exception.

legal-bot: Legal: staging carveout acceptable with documentation. Prod exception needs risk assessment and sign-off.

oscar: Proposal: accept cosign-only for us-east-staging for 25m/75 hosts, pin prod to rc-4.9.9 (sha256:00aa11bb). I'll add a release-note entry.

kim: Attached cosign: `gs://builds/rc-5.0.0/cosign.sig`. To approve: `@deploybot approve-staging --artifact rc-5.0.0 --scope us-east-staging --duration 25m --hosts 75`.

deploybot: Override request received. Policy: provenance missing + ambig license -> manual approval. React with :thumbsup: to approve staging carveout; reply `pin` to pin prod.

security: :thumbsup: approving staging carveout with mitigations. Added extra alerts.

oscar: Pinned prod to rc-4.9.9 in release-config (PR #1501). Starting staging canary: rc-5.0.0 (cosign-only) to us-east-staging for 25m.

legal-bot: Logged carving approval in COM-920. Reminder: follow-up ticket required to hard-fail SBOM upload in CI.

kim: I'll open the pipeline fix PR now and add a unit test to catch provenance upload failures (TKT-4622).

oscar: Thanks — closing thread.
